coaching.headline: Kira farmed twenty kills, twelve off Murdock and Phase, against a team with no tank, and neither allied won fight became a tower or objective.

flags.text: Kira went 20/4/9 with 57,535 hero damage, the game's most; nobody Kira killed built physical armor.
Murdock died fifteen damn times, the most in the game, six to Kira; 12.6k gold to Kira's 18.9k.
Zero tanks and two divers, Grux and Crunch, against Steel's frontline: that shape won 48.2% in 1.18 ranked.
All four enemy pit objectives came with three or four allies dead in the prior minute.

focus.title: A tank in front, towers after wins
focus.action: Draft a tank such as Riktor offlane to take Kira's first hits; Murdock and Phase stay behind that tank, and every won fight goes straight onto the nearest enemy tower.

9.3.call: Lost 4-7, almost every kill on the duo lane, while Steel killed Grux on the offlane in a separate play; enemy Fangtooth followed. With Grux, Crunch, Murdock and Phase all killed in the window, concede Fangtooth and reset as a group.

26.8.call: Lost 0-4: Steel killed Grux in the enemy jungle, then Feng Mao killed Valmont and Murdock at the Fangtooth pit and Phase on the duo lane. Primal Fangtooth went to the enemy next, then the allied mid inhibitor fell. Contest Primal Fangtooth only as five.

28.4.call: Kira scored all five kills in the allied base, and an inner tower, two inhibitors and the Core fell within the same window. Against a fed Kira, the base defense starts with crowd control on Kira.

10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Eleven deaths: four to Kira, four to Feng Mao, three to Morigesh, two outside detected fights. When Feng Mao drops off the map, hold mid under tower until vision returns.
Lowest gold and hero damage of all ten: 9,676 and 13,465. The early duo-lane kill on Feng Mao came right after Murdock fell there; repeat that rotation when duo fights.
17cd1aa1-69ad-4255-ad50-75c058e60a64: Nine deaths against a 3.7 norm, six to Kira. When Kira channels Purge, Kira is slowed and limited to Shadow Glide, so channel Energy Lance onto Kira then.
Kill participation 68%, best among allies, with 3,567 crest healing and 14 wards. When Murdock trades on the duo lane, keep Telekinetic Link on Murdock.
685de7fe-e167-4957-be86-dea77c720cb2: Feng Mao added five deaths to Kira's six, and four deaths came before minute ten. When Feng Mao is unseen, stay behind Phase until the dive shows.
755 hero damage per minute against a 1,085 norm. Purge slows Kira, so drop Static Trap at Kira's feet during Purge and trade back from range.
1fad2e8d-da85-44fd-9563-8ce185336472: Seven deaths, right on a 7.1 norm, three to Steel, with 23,542 damage mitigated. Engage Steel after Shield Slam is spent, and hold stuns through Bull Rush.
8.3 CS per minute beat a 7 norm. A duo-lane death to Kira preceded the allied offlane outer falling; leave the offlane only when Steel shows elsewhere.
b6351280-e177-4938-b860-22adf6740aca: Most kills, hero damage and objective damage among allies: 11, 26,401 and 6,536. River buffs went 7 to 18 against; take river buffs when Feng Mao shows elsewhere.
57,920 damage taken, the most of all ten, and seven deaths against a 5.2 norm. With no allied tank, wait out Narbash's Crash Bang Boom! before entering.

matchup: Morigesh was the lane opponent: three deaths to Morigesh, one kill back.
Feng Mao added four more kills; Earth Shatter executes a hero below a health threshold and grants a recast.
Morigesh's Pestilence deals max-health damage over time from ability hits, and Swarm heals off damage dealt.
build: Azure Core and Entropy are two of the 58.5% core; Overseer never made the build.
Tainted Scepter, bought second and built more often into Morigesh, cuts healing 45% for 4s on magical damage.
Entropy, the last item finished, adds bonus damage on ability hits.
eternal: Demiurge raises item stats and item-effect damage by 10%.
Aion has the best odds in a midlane toss-up; Demiurge is statistically even with Aion.
Bio-Mechanical Fusion with Memory Leak is the best Demiurge pair; Tri-Core with Memory Leak ranks third of three.
augment: Sanguine Banquet grants omnivamp that scales with bonus mana, and minion kills raise max mana.
Rupturing Fangs has the best odds in a toss-up; Sanguine Banquet, the most played, is statistically even.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima active gives a shield plus 20% magical lifesteal and 10% movement speed for 8s.
Epoch is clearly the best crest in this midlane field; Soulbearer ranks second among crests with enough games.
Epoch and Soulbearer both evolve from Wizard Crest.
improvement: Overseer, after Entropy, completes the 58.5% core; Tainted Scepter stays for Morigesh and Kira self-healing.
Physical damage taken from heroes hit 21,234 with no armor built; a physical armor item answers Kira and Feng Mao.
Epoch over Soulbearer is the field-backed crest swap: a stasis escape, giving up the shield and lifesteal burst.

matchup: Duo with Murdock against Kira and Narbash; the allied duo died six times before minute ten, the enemy duo four.
Kira's Purge lifesteals and applies Blight; Narbash's Thunk and Crash Bang Boom! both stun.
Narbash healed 20,194, the game's most; this support healed 13,165.
build: The most played core into Narbash, Marshal, Enra's Blessing and Galaxy Greaves at 65.6%, went unbuilt.
Tainted Rounds cuts healing 45% for 3s, but only on successful basic attacks.
Nuclear Rounds, finished last, raises ability damage 10-20% based on critical chance.
eternal: Weald fires true-damage missiles after damaging a hero below 30% health.
Weald has too few support games here to lead; Exarch leans ahead of Aion in that field.
Dryad's Boon with Wind-Rider edges the Dryad's Boon and Taproot run among Weald pairs.
augment: Kindred Surge adds 10% movement speed and health regen for the full Hyperflux duration.
Kindred Surge has the best odds in a toss-up with Psychic Support. Sound keep.
crest: Tranquility's Grace active heals the wearer and nearby heroes and grants 10% damage mitigation for 2s.
Silentium and Tranquility are statistically even in this support field; Silentium has the best odds.
Silentium and Tranquility both evolve from Keeper Crest.
improvement: No armor was built against Kira; physical armor in place of Nuclear Rounds answers that physical damage.
Exarch over Weald is the field-backed swap: heals and shields grant attack speed and magical on-hit, giving up low-health missiles.

matchup: Kira won the head-to-head six kills to two.
First blood went to Narbash on the duo lane.
Takedowns refresh Kira's Shadow Glide, so every feed extends the chase.
build: Lightning Hawk and Tainted Rounds are two of the 59% winning core; Imperator never made the build.
Vanquisher executes heroes taken below 5% health.
Onixian Quiver, finished last, adds two extra projectiles per ranged basic attack.
eternal: Weald punishes low-health heroes with true-damage missiles that travel through walls.
Thraex leans ahead in this carry field; Weald ranks third among Eternals with enough games.
Forage with Taproot is the best Weald pair; Forage with Barkskin ranks third of three qualifying pairs.
augment: Justice's Reach makes Shots Fired pierce units with extra range.
Justice's Reach leans ahead in this carry field. Sound keep.
crest: Eviscerator's Rending Strikes active adds attack speed, omnivamp and on-hit damage.
Pacifier is clearly the best crest in this carry field; Eviscerator ranks second among crests with enough games.
Pacifier and Eviscerator both evolve from Sharpshooter Crest.
improvement: Kira dealt 54,536 physical hero damage and no armor item was built; physical armor answers that damage.
Pacifier over Eviscerator is the field-backed crest swap: a short dash and empowered hit, giving up the omnivamp burst.
Thraex over Weald trades low-health true-damage missiles for a marked duel target.

matchup: Steel was the lane opponent: three kills in the matchup, no kill back, and one death all game.
Steel's Bull Rush is unstoppable, and Shield Slam knocks up and stuns.
build: Sky Splitter and Basilisk are two of the 67.8% core; Tainted Blade never made the build.
Basilisk, built more often into Steel, shreds physical armor on every hero hit, stacking six times.
Rapture adds on-hit damage near an enemy plus omnivamp.
eternal: Thraex marks the last hero basic-attacked for bonus damage and reduced damage taken from that hero.
Nihil leans ahead of Thraex in this offlane field.
Savage Strikes with Ferocity is the best Thraex pair. Sound keep on minors.
augment: Chieftain's Blink cuts Blink cooldown by 35%.
Chieftain's Blink has too few offlane games here to lead; Red Mist is clearly the field's best.
crest: Judgement's Thunder Cleaver deals area damage and heals on hero hits.
Iceskorn Talons leans ahead of Judgement in this offlane field; both evolve from Champion Crest.
improvement: Tainted Blade completes the 67.8% core and cuts healing on any physical damage into Kira, Narbash and Morigesh.
Into Steel, Salvation adds tenacity against the Shield Bash and Shield Slam stuns.
Red Mist over Chieftain's Blink is the field-backed swap: attack speed per Bloodlust target, giving up Blink cooldown.

matchup: Feng Mao was the jungle opponent; the jungle matchup traded two kills each way.
Feng Mao's Safeguard spellshield blocks an ability, and Reaping Dash cooldown drops on takedowns.
build: Augmentation and Tainted Blade are two of the 61.1% core; Berserker's Axe never made the build.
Tainted Blade cuts healing 45% on any physical damage, an answer to Narbash's 20,194 healing.
Mutilator deals 1% max-health damage per basic attack and applies three times on ability hits.
eternal: Thraex rewards sticking to one basic-attack target, and Savage Strikes heals for the on-hit damage dealt.
Pilow and Lotus tie for the lead in this jungle field; Thraex ranks fifth among Eternals with enough games.
augment: Combo Crunch grants stacking attack speed when Cross Crunch deals damage.
Combo Crunch has the best odds in a toss-up with Lunge Crunch. Sound keep.
crest: Iceskorn Talons creates an ice sheet: allies on the sheet gain physical power and speed, enemies are slowed.
Gravitum is clearly the best crest in this jungle field; Iceskorn Talons ranks fourth with enough games.
improvement: Berserker's Axe in place of Earthshaker completes the 61.1% core with Augmentation and Tainted Blade.
Gravitum over Iceskorn Talons is the field-backed crest swap: a long-range grounding shot, giving up the team speed sheet.
Pilow over Thraex makes ability casts weaken nearby enemy damage, giving up the duel mark.

threats: Heal-stacking: Narbash. Anti-heal is mandatory against this comp — we brought 4 items of it.
Dive threat on our backline: Feng Mao. Assign peel for the carry and ward the flanks.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s), Crunch Right Crunch (knockup 1.25s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
We have sustain (Phase) — favor the longer fight where our heals out-grind them.
Our damage is 4/5 physical — predictable; the enemy itemizes one armor item against most of it. A magical pick would split their defenses.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Telekinetic Link a carry, Psychic Flare around both of you to blind enemies facing it, Energy Lance to stack slows into a root, and Hyperflux to give both of you attack speed, ability haste and speed.
ourKits.winCondition: Power up a linked carry with the Link and Hyperflux and keep them healthy with Essence Catalyst healing.
ourKits.passive: Essence Catalyst: abilities heal her and her linked ally over time, and her Phase Blink has a shorter cooldown and boosts her damage.
ourKits.playWith: The strongest carry to Link, ideally one who wants attack speed and ability haste.
ourKits.playAgainst: Turn away from Psychic Flare, since it only blinds enemies facing it, and break Energy Lance's beam before it reaches the root. Anti-heal cuts the shared healing; focus the linked carry or force the Link out of range.

ourKits.combo: Stampede to drag a target, Smash 'n Grab to pull and stun, Warlord's Challenge to stun and steal power, then Double Pain to cleave and heal.
ourKits.winCondition: Chain pull and stuns onto one target while Bloodlust bleed stacks and Warlord's Challenge attack speed shred them.
ourKits.passive: Bloodlust makes basics stack a bleed for damage over time.
ourKits.playWith: Follow-up damage that can hit the target he drags and stuns.
ourKits.playAgainst: Stampede has a delay before the charge and Smash 'n Grab channels before the shockwave, so sidestep both. Fight after he spends them, and buy anti-heal against Double Pain's heal.

ourKits.combo: Forward Crunch dashes in to stun, Left Crunch and Right Crunch build Turbo, then the Turbo Crunch version (long push dash, true-damage double swipe, or knockup uppercut) lands, with Re-Crunch repeating the last ability
ourKits.winCondition: chain abilities into Turbo Crunch empowered hits and heal through Re-Crunch's passive
ourKits.passive: each ability empowers his next basic attack and cuts his cooldowns; two ability casts activate Turbo Crunch, enhancing his next basic ability
ourKits.playWith: engage and peel-stripping teammates so he can reach the backline
ourKits.playAgainst: fight after Forward Crunch is used, since it is his long-cooldown gap closer; respect his second ability cast because the next one is Turbo-enhanced; anti-heal blunts Re-Crunch healing and armor helps against his physical damage

ourKits.combo: Root a target with Static Trap, shred armor with Buckshot, stack attack speed with Hot Pursuit and finish with the long-range Charged shot or Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.winCondition: Control space with traps and out-range enemies with Charged basic attacks, then snipe low targets anywhere with Long Arm of the Law.
ourKits.passive: Shots Fired: after 5 landed basic attacks his next one gains extra range and bonus damage.
ourKits.playWith: A frontline or peeling support, since his only escape tools are Buckshot's push back and Hot Pursuit's speed.
ourKits.playAgainst: Avoid fighting over Static Traps and engage after Buckshot is used, since it is his push-back peel. Stay out of the ult line at low health; armor does not help against Long Arm of the Law.

ourKits.combo: Arterial Grip to ground and slow → Bloodbound for attack speed → basics to trigger Hemophagia → Exsanguinate bats to heal
ourKits.winCondition: bind a target with Arterial Grip and out-sustain them with Hemophagia strikes and Exsanguinate's healing
ourKits.passive: Hemophagia makes Lilith strike targets hit by his basics or Bloodbound, and takedowns restore mana
ourKits.playWith: frontliners who keep enemies in range so his bind and bats keep landing
ourKits.playAgainst: Arterial Grip breaks if you CC him, break line of sight, or get far enough away; buy anti-heal against Exsanguinate and magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
enemyKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
enemyKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
enemyKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
enemyKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

enemyKits.combo: Thunk to knock back and stun, March! to boost his current Song aura for the team, then channel Crash Bang Boom! to stack slows into a Mesmerize and finish with a knock up and stun.
enemyKits.winCondition: Start fights with Thunk and keep the team moving or healing with Song of My People and March!, then lock a group with his ult.
enemyKits.passive: Mosh Pit: he gains physical power and both armors for each nearby hero, ally or enemy.
enemyKits.playWith: A brawling team that rides his speed or healing aura into fights and follows up on his ult.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Sidestep the small Thunk area, and walk out of Crash Bang Boom! early since he slows himself while channeling and it only Mesmerizes at max stacks. Spread out so Mosh Pit gives him fewer stacks.

enemyKits.combo: Reaping Dash in, Hamstring twice to slow, Safeguard to block the key ability, then Earth Shatter to execute and recast on a kill
enemyKits.winCondition: trade with Safeguard up and chain Earth Shatter executes and Reaping Dash cooldown resets in fights
enemyKits.passive: unique hero takedowns permanently grant bonus physical penetration, and all his physical penetration is increased
enemyKits.playWith: setup that holds a target for the Earth Shatter execute
enemyKits.playAgainst: bait Safeguard's Spellshield before committing your key CC; back off when low, since Earth Shatter executes and recasts on a kill; armor counters his physical damage

enemyKits.combo: Bull Rush in unstoppable to knock back → Shield Bash stun → Shield Slam knockup and stun, Force Shield to block projectiles
enemyKits.winCondition: engage with Shield Slam or Bull Rush and protect carries with Force Shield's projectile wall
enemyKits.passive: a self-shield that lasts until broken and refreshes when out of damage, plus hybrid armor
enemyKits.playWith: ranged carries he can shield from enemy projectiles, and follow-up damage for his engages
enemyKits.playAgainst: Bull Rush is unstoppable, so do not waste CC into it; walk around Force Shield instead of shooting into it, and fight after Shield Slam is on cooldown

enemyKits.combo: Mark a hero, land Hive to slow and stack Pestilence, run through them with Swarm, then cast Curse on the Marked target to cash the Mark in.
enemyKits.winCondition: Keep Pestilence stacked on a squishy with Hive and Swarm, then finish them with Curse while Mark and Swarm heal her through the trade.
enemyKits.passive: Pestilence: her damaging abilities stack a max-health magical damage over time, and Fetid Dagger hits refresh it.
enemyKits.playWith: Lane partners or junglers with setup that hold her Marked target in place for Curse.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Dodge Hive, since its slow sets up everything else, and trade when Swarm is down because it is her damage reduction, speed and main heal. Anti-heal cuts the healing from Mark and Swarm.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,984 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Kira carry players this patch (36% of the team's). The damage came from Scattershot, Solaris, Necrosis.
Purge at top rank: 105s base, about 95.5s by the end (9% shorter) from 10 ability haste: Solaris 10.
Necrosis (Necro's Edge): Gain 25 Ultimate Haste.
Necrosis (Matter Disruptor): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Kira dealt 57,535 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +190 physical power from items.

Penetration: Vanquisher 12; against Phase (level 15 estimated: about 92 physical armor, 80 after penetration) and Murdock (level 15 estimated: about 96 physical armor, 84 after penetration) that is about 7% and 7% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Scattershot (item): Upon successful On-Hit Attack: Summon 2 projectiles from the Target. These home towards the closest Enemies. Each deals (+40%) Damage. Applies On-Hit effects at 50% effectiveness.
Solaris (item): On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.
Necrosis (item): Your Ultimate Ability deals 15% more damage.
Sustain: Solaris: On Ability Cast: Empower your next Basic Attack within 4s. Deal 45 (+35%) Damage On-Hit. Can Critically Strike. Heals you for 50% of damage dealt.; 4,399 healing recorded.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Scattershot, Solaris.
Countered? 0 of the 5 players Kira killed built physical armor. We killed Kira 4 times.
Copy it? Too few Kira carry games with this Eternal or core this patch to say whether it wins elsewhere.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,508 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Feng Mao jungle players this patch (27% of the team's). The damage came from Manta Scythe, Tainted Trident, Draconum.
Earth Shatter at top rank: 85s base, about 63s by the end (26% shorter) from 35 ability haste: Tainted Trident 10, Draconum 15, Infernum 10.
25 takedowns (15 kills, 10 assists) fed: Draconum (Flow), Executioners Path (passive).
Feng Mao dealt 43,723 hero damage, 27% of their team's, with +220 physical power from items.

Penetration: Manta Scythe 10, Tainted Trident 11, Painweaver 10, Infernum 9; against Murdock (level 15 estimated: about 96 physical armor, 56 after penetration) and Valmont (level 15 estimated: about 101 physical armor, 61 after penetration) that is about 26% and 25% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Manta Scythe (item): Against Enemy Units within 2500u: If they have no Ally within 1000u of themselves, deal 8% more damage to them.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Draconum (item): On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.
Infernum (item): Damaging Abilities and Basic Attacks: Apply stacks of Kindling to Enemy Units for 2.5s. At 4 stacks, ignite them. Deals 4 (+1.5%)% of their Max Health as Damage over 2s.
Infernum (item): Based on Enemy Bonus Armor: For each point, Cinder deals 0.8% more Damage.

Sustain: 7% lifesteal; Draconum: On dealing damage to Heroes or Monsters: Gain 2% increased Healing for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.; Draconum: On Takedown: Restore (+120%)(+6%) Health.; 14,142 healing recorded.
Toughness: +40 physical armor; took 36,959 damage, mitigated 26,941, died 5 times.

Lesson: Feng Mao's penetration cut through: Murdock took about 26% more physical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 (estimated) their armor was about 96, about 56 after 40 flat penetration).
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Infernum.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Manta Scythe, Draconum.

bullets: Casting Mercy or Dusk empowered Kira's next basic attack through Solaris, on a short cooldown; that hit could critically strike and healed Kira for 50% of the damage.
Every third basic attack in a row on one hero within 2.5s set off Vermis maximum-health damage plus Serration missing-health damage; Melting Point hurt heavily armored targets more.
Necrosis made Purge deal 15% more damage; Shadow Glide, still usable during Purge, reset on takedowns, so each takedown gave another dash and Physical Power stack.
Forticus shielded Steel on taking hero damage, then cooled down; Transference turned leftover shield into health when a shield expired, keeping Steel in fights after trades.
Krix raised maximum health, growing Cybernetic Shell; Cannibalism added 25 maximum health per takedown; Festering Wounds briefly cut enemy heroes' healing 45% after Shield Bash or Shield Slam.
Shield Bash or Bull Rush casts empowered a basic attack within 4s through Elafrost, on a short cooldown: health-scaled damage around the target plus a 35% slow.
Takedowns cut Reaping Dash's current cooldown by 80%, and executing a hero with Earth Shatter allowed a free recast within 14s, chaining one takedown into the next.
Lotus gave random boosts every 2 minutes and on takedowns; Masterpiece stacked brief damage and speed per kill; Prima Donna: 10% more hero damage, 6% more damage taken.
Every physical hit applied Tainted Trident's healing cut, so Hamstring and Reaping Dash dealt extra damage; Manta Scythe added 8% against enemies with no ally within 1000 units.
